title: Evaluate the scratch Gaussian classifier
description: You compare Iris predictions with test labels and read their confusion matrix.

steps.description: You load Iris and split the data with stratify=y. This requests a split that preserves class proportions.
You fit the scratch Gaussian classifier on training rows and predict test rows. The recorded accuracy is 0.920.

steps.question: In the plotted confusion matrix, do rows identify true or predicted labels?
steps.answer: Rows identify true labels, and columns identify predicted labels. The axis labels state this orientation.

steps.description: You label both axes with species names and write each count inside its cell. The recorded matrix has diagonal counts 16, 16, and 14, with four off-diagonal errors.
